mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, always-on.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth exceeds 200K, the tight labor market drives wage inflation, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 3% signals increased economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: Real disposable income (RSAFS) growth above 5% boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, always-on.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) growth exceeds 3%, the hawkish monetary stance negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth below 100K signals a slowdown in labor market momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 4% signals strong economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, always-on, but with reduced effectiveness during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, excluding easing cycles.
